SELECT part.PART_NUMBER_SHORT as partNumber, SUM(IF(xm.STATUS = 107, 1, 0)) AS inventory, SUM(IF(xm.STATUS = 110, 1, 0)) AS outForRepair, SUM(IF(xm.STATUS = 108, 1, 0)) AS quarantine, SUM(IF(xm.STATUS = 111, 1, 0)) AS awaitingQaCa, SUM(IF(xm.STATUS = 112, 1, 0)) AS readyToShip, COUNT(mo.MO_OID) AS TOTAL FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_ORDER mo JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_MATERIALS xm USING (MO_OID) JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER msn USING (MSN_OID) JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_PART part USING (PART_OID) WHERE mo.MC_OID = #{id} AND xm.STATUS IN (107, 110, 108, 111, 112)
AND part.PART_NUMBER_SHORT LIKE concat('%',#{partNumber},'%')
AND mo.MO_OID LIKE concat('%',#{rmaNumber},'%')
AND msn.SERIAL_NUMBER LIKE concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
GROUP BY part.PART_NUMBER_SHORT;

SELECT mo.MO_OID as rmaNumber, SUM(IF(xm.STATUS = 107, 1, 0)) AS inventory, SUM(IF(xm.STATUS = 110, 1, 0)) AS outForRepair, SUM(IF(xm.STATUS = 108, 1, 0)) AS quarantine, SUM(IF(xm.STATUS = 111, 1, 0)) AS awaitingQaCa, SUM(IF(xm.STATUS = 112, 1, 0)) AS readyToShip, COUNT(msn.SERIAL_NUMBER) AS total FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_ORDER mo JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_MATERIALS xm USING (MO_OID) JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER msn USING (MSN_OID) JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_PART part USING (PART_OID) WHERE mo.MC_OID = #{id} AND xm.STATUS IN (107, 110, 108, 111, 112)
AND mo.MO_OID LIKE concat('%',#{rmaNumber},'%')
AND msn.SERIAL_NUMBER LIKE concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
GROUP BY part.PART_NUMBER_SHORT, mo.MO_OID HAVING part.PART_NUMBER_SHORT = #{partNumber};

SELECT msn.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber, IF(xm.STATUS = 107, 1, 0) AS inventory, IF(xm.STATUS = 110, 1, 0) AS outForRepair, IF(xm.STATUS = 108, 1, 0) AS quarantine, IF(xm.STATUS = 111, 1, 0) AS awaitingQaCa, IF(xm.STATUS = 112, 1, 0) AS readyToShip FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_ORDER mo JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_MATERIALS xm USING (MO_OID) JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER msn USING (MSN_OID) JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_PART part USING (PART_OID) WHERE mo.MC_OID = #{id} AND xm.STATUS IN (107, 110, 108, 111, 112) AND part.PART_NUMBER_SHORT = #{partNumber} AND mo.MO_OID = #{rmaNumber}
AND msn.SERIAL_NUMBER LIKE concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
